user.title: Connect RP326
user.description: Select the RP326 RS-232 serial proxy or local serial port. Match the baud rate to the printer self-test page. An ESP32 requires a MAX3232 level converter. Disable hardware status for transmit-only wiring or unsupported firmware.

data.name: Printer name
data.status_enabled: Enable hardware status (requires printer TX → ESP RX)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure RP326
reconfigure.description: Change the printer connection. The existing port will be released while the new settings are checked.

data.name: Printer name
data.status_enabled: Enable hardware status (requires printer TX → ESP RX)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the serial port. Check that ESPHome is connected and the port is not in use.
error.no_response: No status reply. Check power, baud and RX wiring, or disable hardware status for transmit-only printing.
error.invalid_response: Invalid status reply. Check baud rate, wiring and printer status-command support.
error.proxy_not_ready: ESPHome is still loading. Wait until the ESPHome device is connected, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.
abort.cannot_unload: Cannot release the current serial port. Reload the integration and try again.
